summary: Iteration 8 re-architecture verification. Preview is unaffected as designed: /app/frontend/build does NOT exist so the new spa_fallback block in server.py is dead code. All 11 backend smoke tests pass (regression + iter8-specific SPA-safety asserts). All 4 frontend routes (/, /transactions, /test, /setup) load with HTTP 200 and 0 console errors on the preview URL. Setup page still shows gpay-accounts panel with count '1 active / 3 total'. /api/* routing is intact — /api/status still 200, /api/definitely-not-real returns 404 from FastAPI router (not swallowed).

smoke_results.GET /some/spa/route: 200 React HTML — served by preview ingress -> :3000 dev server (NOT by backend spa_fallback which is dead code because build dir absent)

spa_fallback_review: server.py:412-432 correctly guards mounting with `if FRONTEND_DIR.exists()`. Preview has no /app/frontend/build so the block is skipped entirely — no `/static` mount, no catch-all route registered. Even if it were active, the guard `if full_path.startswith('api/') or full_path == 'api'` prevents interception of API paths, and FastAPI evaluates included routers before the catch-all mount so /api/* always resolves first. Safe.
critical_code_review_comments: SPA fallback guard is correct — checks both `full_path.startswith('api/')` and equality with 'api'. Router precedence (app.include_router before mount) makes this defense-in-depth.

Minor: the spa_fallback route registration path could optionally emit a log line on startup for local-runner visibility (`logger.info('Serving SPA from ...')`), so users know static assets are being served. Optional, not blocking.
seed_data_creation: One TEST_iter8 GPay account was created & deleted within test lifecycle; no residue.
